# AI Lawyer

> AI Lawyer provides AI-powered legal guidance, document templates, and lawyer cost insights to help individuals navigate legal matters affordably.

AI Lawyer combines legal technology with practical resources including free templates, cost guides for various legal services, and a partner affiliate program. The platform serves users seeking legal information and document assistance across multiple practice areas including immigration, business, personal injury, and family law.
